Zeppelin Hotel Tech AG: Change to the financial calendar – no publication of the half-year report 2026

In light of the application for delisting from the Vienna MTF in connection with the planned merger with ReGuest S.p.A. (see the ad hoc announcement of Zeppelin Hotel Tech S.p.A. dated 25 September 2026), Zeppelin Hotel Tech S.p.A. ("ZHT", ISIN: IT0005667032) announces that it will not publish the voluntary half-year report 2026 that was scheduled in its financial calendar for 30-09-2026
Zeppelin Hotel Tech is redefining hospitality digitalization with an instant-ready technology platform.
Hotels can launch a high-performance website in 30 days
activate data-driven marketing campaigns in 2 days
manage their entire digital presence through one seamless ecosystem — without the delays, costs, or complexity of traditional agencies.

The vision of the Zeppelin Hotel Tech S.p.A. is to build a platform that becomes exponentially smarter over time, using automation and intelligence to drive direct bookings, maximize marketing ROI, and give hoteliers full control over their digital growth. Fast, automated. agency-free, Scalable. With these objectives and their ready to go software-solutions the Zeppelin Hotel Tech S.p.A. intends to redefine the future of hotel marketing funnels as a software as a service model.

This notification is a mandatory notification pursuant to Article 17 of the Market Abuse Regulation. This announcement does not constitute an offer to buy securities or a solicitation of an offer to buy securities of Zeppelin Hotel Tech AG. Any future offer of securities of the Company will be made in accordance with and on the basis of the applicable capital market regulations.
